activity.notes: Russell served as the presiding Supreme Judge of Oregon's Provisional Government before entering the second Executive Committee. The Civ label 'Cascadia' is not used because Cascadia is a later bioregional/political concept rather than the historical polity Russell served.

sources.title: Petitions to Congress, 1838–1845 — Oregon Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The Oregon Encyclopedia identifies Osborne Russell as a member of the Provisional Government's executive branch in 1845 and signer of the June 1845 petition to Congress.
